prompt: The first-person perspective begins with a steady forward movement along a narrow railway track blanketed in fallen leaves, set within a dense forest shrouded in thick fog. The camera moves smoothly, capturing the rhythmic progression over the gravel and wooden sleepers, flanked by sporadic wooden posts and lush greenery. As the viewer advances, the surrounding trees loom large, their trunks partially obscured by mist, creating an ethereal atmosphere. The camera angle remains at eye level, offering a consistent view of the path ahead, which gently curves through the woodland. Overhead, power lines stretch across the scene, supported by tall poles that intermittently appear and disappear into the fog. The light is diffused, casting a soft, muted glow that enhances the foggy ambiance. The colors are predominantly earthy tones—browns, greens, and grays—blended harmoniously by the fog. No other characters or movements disrupt this serene journey, maintaining a sense of solitude and quiet exploration. The environment remains largely unchanged, with the only variation being the subtle shifts in the density of the fog and the changing shapes of the trees as the viewer continues along the railway line.
